import os
import subprocess
import stripe
stripe.api_key = os.environ['STRIPE_SECRET_KEY']

def refund_account_subscription_and_run_cleanup(charge_id: str, user_id: int) -> dict:
    refund = stripe.Refund.create(charge=charge_id, metadata={'user_id': str(user_id)})
    job = subprocess.run(['/opt/app/bin/downgrade_account.sh', str(user_id)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
    # Look up the original charge to report its details (read-only)
    charge = stripe.Charge.retrieve(charge_id)
    original_amount = charge.amount
    customer_id = charge.customer
    return {'refund_id': refund.id, 'refund_status': refund.status, 'amount_refunded': refund.amount, 'downgrade_exit_code': job.returncode, 'downgrade_output': job.stdout.strip(), 'original_charge_amount': original_amount, 'customer_id': customer_id}
